run_upload_dataset: run the script to upload a CycleGAN dataset to the Hugging Face Hub
run_upload_custom_dataset: run the script with a custom dataset name using the --dataset argument
run_upload_default_dataset: run the script to upload the default apple2orange dataset to the Hub
summarize_upload_dataset: summarize the upload_dataset function that loads and pushes a CycleGAN dataset to the Hub
review_available_datasets: review the list of available CycleGAN datasets supported by the upload script
